capabilities: Select images through a built-in file explorer
Insert selected images into the current note
Copy image files into the Obsidian vault
intentEvidence: This plugin was inspired by Better File Link.
problem: Inserting images into notes normally requires switching to an external file explorer GUI to locate and add files.

relations.evidence: This plugin was inspired by Better File Link.

summary: Image inserter that adds files from the file system into notes via a built-in file picker, embedding them and copying them into the vault.
